name: Winter’s Breath
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level druid 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 15 ft.
Area 15-ft. cone
Duration instantaneous, 1 round
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

You breathe out a 15-foot cone of freezing frost. You deal 1d6 points of cold damage per caster level (maximum 10d6) to every creature within the area. In addition to the cold damage, they are also staggered for 1 round.
